features.name: One-tap recording
features.description: A large record button starts a recording. A bottom sheet offers record audio, upload a file, write a note or record a phone call. The recording view shows a waveform, a timer, a live transcription toggle, cancel, pause and stop.
features.reason: The main function. AVAudioRecorder on the device, no network.

features.name: Unlimited recording length
features.description: Record lectures and meetings of several hours without a time limit.
features.reason: Only disk space limits a local recording. Long-form transcription needs chunking on iOS 17 (SFSpeechRecognizer) or SpeechAnalyzer on iOS 26.

features.name: Background and locked-screen recording
features.description: Recording continues with the screen locked or while using other apps.
features.reason: UIBackgroundModes audio. Reviews report recordings that end with 'no data' or keep only the first 2 minutes: reliability matters.

features.name: Live transcription toggle
features.description: During recording the user can switch live transcription on or off.
features.reason: On-device recogniser in parallel with the recorder; can also transcribe after stopping.

features.name: Transcript with speaker labels and timestamps
features.description: Timestamped transcript with labelled speakers, automatic punctuation, capitals and paragraph breaks. Speakers can be renamed.
features.reason: Transcript, punctuation and timestamps are on-device. Automatic speaker labels are not available from Apple APIs: manual labels only, or a decision.

features.name: Processing progress
features.description: After stopping, a progress screen shows stages: uploading, transcribing, identifying speakers, summarising.
features.reason: On the device there is no upload; a simple progress for file transcription is enough.

features.name: Many transcription languages with auto-detect
features.description: Searchable language picker with auto-detect; summary language set separately.
features.reason: SFSpeechRecognizer.supportedLocales filtered by supportsOnDeviceRecognition; no auto-detect on device, so the user picks the language (default: device language).

features.name: Translation
features.description: Record in one language and translate the transcript into another.
features.reason: Translation framework (iOS 17.4 sheet, TranslationSession on iOS 18) works on-device after a language download. Outside the one function: decision.

features.name: AI summary, action items and highlights
features.description: Summary tab with a paragraph, action items with assignee and description, highlights, next steps and conclusion. Edit panel to change summary length, language and template.
features.reason: Server LLM in the original. On the device only Foundation Models on iOS 26 with Apple Intelligence: needs a decision.

features.name: AI chat on a recording
features.description: Chat tab where the user asks questions about the recording, with suggested prompts.
features.reason: Cloud LLM; a local version would need Foundation Models and goes beyond transcribing.

features.name: Import audio files and PDF
features.description: Upload audio files (and PDF documents) to transcribe or summarise.
features.reason: fileImporter for audio and transcription of the file on the device. PDF summary is out of scope.

features.name: YouTube link transcription
features.description: Paste a YouTube link to get a transcript and summary; YouTube items have their own filter.
features.reason: Requires network and downloading third-party content.

features.name: Phone call recording
features.description: Record phone calls through a service with phone verification; limited to 100 minutes per month.
features.reason: Requires a server-side call bridge and an account.

features.name: Bot for online meetings
features.description: Connect Google or Outlook calendar; a bot joins meetings automatically and must be admitted.
features.reason: Account, server and calendar integration.

features.name: Search with timestamps
features.description: Search field on the home; inside a note, type a word and jump to that point of the recording.
features.reason: Local text search on transcripts with segment timestamps.

features.name: Audio player
features.description: Player at the bottom of the note with position slider and total time.
features.reason: AVAudioPlayer; local.

features.name: Export and share
features.description: Share button with Share summary (text) and Share PDF; transcript as PDF or text; share sheet with AirDrop, Messages, Mail, link.
features.reason: ShareLink with text and a PDF rendered on the device. Shared links need a server: skip that part.

features.name: Library with filters, favourites and folders
features.description: Home list with title, emoji icon, source, time and duration; chips All, Favorites, Folders, YouTube; folders with name, colour and emoji; multi-select with move, merge, favourite, delete.
features.reason: Local organisation. Emoji icons and coloured folders conflict with the design system (one accent, SF Symbols only).

features.name: Trash with 30-day expiry
features.description: Deleted notes go to a trash and are deleted after 30 days.
features.reason: Local soft delete; protects against accidental loss.

features.name: Typed notes with voice input
features.description: Create a text note by typing or dictating.
features.reason: A note-taking app is a different function.

features.name: Apple Watch recording
features.description: Record from the Watch; recordings sync to the phone.
features.reason: watchOS target with WatchConnectivity; local but a second product. Reviews report lost Watch recordings.

features.name: Widgets and Shortcut
features.description: Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets with a microphone to start recording; Shortcut setup.
features.reason: WidgetKit plus App Intents; local.

features.name: Account, sign-in and cloud storage
features.description: Sign in with Apple or Google required; encrypted cloud storage; sign in on desktop.
features.reason: Accounts and cloud are forbidden by the product rules; Sbu keeps data on the device.

features.name: Tracking prompt, rating prompt and social proof in onboarding
features.description: App Tracking Transparency prompt at launch, rating request and testimonials before the paywall.
features.reason: Tracking and paywall patterns are forbidden.

screens.name: Onboarding
screens.purpose: Sell the subscription before first use.
elements: splash and intro with Get Started
about eight feature screens with Continue
paywall with 3-day free trial toggle, weekly and yearly plans

screens.name: Library (home)
elements: filter chips: All, Favorites, Folders, YouTube
rows with emoji thumbnail, title, source badge, date or time, duration, more button

screens.name: New item sheet
screens.purpose: Choose the source of a new note.

screens.name: Note: Summary
elements: sections: Summary, Action Items with assignee chips, Highlights, Next Steps, Conclusion
audio player with slider at the bottom

screens.name: Note: Chat
screens.purpose: Ask the AI about the recording.

screens.name: Settings
elements: account: email, log out, delete account
integrations: calendars, Apple Watch, desktop sign-in

flows.name: First launch
steps: Feature tour, notification permission, privacy, rating, testimonials
Empty library with a prompt to start the first recording

flows.name: Record and summarise
steps: Tap New and choose Record audio
Stop: progress through upload, transcription, speakers, summary
Note opens on the Summary tab

flows.name: Share a summary
steps: Choose Share summary or Share PDF
Pick the destination in the share sheet

data_model.storage: Cloud with an account (encrypted, per the listing). For Sbu: SwiftData and audio files on the device only.

monetization.model: Free download with a hard or soft paywall right after onboarding; weekly, monthly and yearly auto-renewing subscriptions with a 3-day free trial.
monetization.price: Weekly 5.99-8.99 USD, monthly 17.99 USD, yearly 79.99-99.99 USD (App Store in-app purchase list).
paywalled_features: recording beyond one lecture per day on the free tier
phone calls (100 min/month even when paid)
monetization.notes: Paywall appears after feature tour, rating prompt and testimonials; the free trial toggle is on by default. Italian review: '3 giorni di prova poi costa un botto'.
